name: AutoDustboot
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Automatically retracts dust boot during tool changes. Safe zones (beta) keep the boot at a safe height over clamps, fixtures and rails.

name: Dust Docker Dust Boot
author: slgreen22
description: Automatically docks and retrieves a mechanical CNC dust boot around M6 tool changes.

name: Rapid Change ATC
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Automatic tool changer support for Rapid Change ATC system.

name: Manual Tool Changer
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Manual tool change workflow with Tool Length Setter (TLS) support.

name: ToolBench
author: Francis Marasigan
description: G-code generator for surfacing, jointing, and boring operations.

name: BoxJoints
author: Francis Marasigan
description: G-code generator for box joint (finger joint) operations for CNC woodworking.

name: Replicator
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Replicate loaded G-code program in a grid pattern for batch production.

name: 3DMesh
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Surface mesh probing with Z compensation for milling curved materials using flat programming.

name: Edge Align
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Material alignment by edge probing — measure the angle of rotation and apply XY compensation to your G-code.

name: Fusion 360 Tool Library Import
author: cotepat
description: Import tool libraries from Fusion 360 (JSON exports or clipboard).

name: G-code Explorer
author: stmoha
description: G-code reference, line explainer, and toolpath navigator in one. Type ?keyword in the Console to look up any G/M-code or controller setting (grblHAL, Grbl 1.1, FluidNC), ??<line> to explain a line word by word, browse the docs and NC manual, or use the Explorer tab to snap to G-code lines on a 2D map, jog the machine, trace the cut outline, and unwrap 4th-axis jobs.

name: Pneumatic ATC (Beta)
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Pneumatic automatic tool changer workflow. Uses a single aux output to clamp/unclamp the collet. Beta — for testing only.

name: Pendant
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Wireless pendant activation and firmware updates.

name: RGB LED (Beta)
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Wireless RGB LED accessory — the strip mirrors the app's machine status (green while running, red on alarm, fireworks on job complete). Beta — for testing only.

name: QuickCut
author: Francis Marasigan
description: G-code generator for common CNC ops — rectangles, circles, polygons, planer, jointer, and cutter (parting).

name: Spoilboard Toolbox
author: tmuka
description: Zero on your spoilboard's dog holes in two taps: jog near a hole and X0 Y0 snaps to it exactly, no probing or typed coordinates. Swap work Z0 between spoilboard and stock top for any measured tool without re-probing. Fit the grid to the real board by probe or by eye, then cut the dog holes, T-tracks, chamfers and labels, and drill bolt or flip-pin holes through stock, from the same grid. Formerly Zero Swapper. For grblHAL.

name: ncCAM (Beta)
author: Francis Marasigan
description: Turn a STEP part into G-code with the tools in your Tool Library: finds the pockets, holes, steps and outline, sets speeds and feeds for the material, and previews the cut as material is removed. 2.5D parts cut from the top. Beta.

name: Rotary CAM (Beta)
author: stmoha
description: Simultaneous 4th-axis CAM for a rotary parallel to X: open an STL or STEP part, rough it in spiral layers, finish it with a continuous ball-mill spiral around A, clean up under overhangs with indexed passes, and simulate it against the stock before loading the G-code. Uses your Tool Library; posts grblHAL G-code. Beta.

name: Gears
author: tmuka
description: Design spur gears, a rack and pinion or a ring gear, and cut them from ncSender: start from the center distance and ratio, watch them mesh, Generate. True involute teeth rounded at the root to fit your bit, backlash for wood and plastic, bores and lightening holes, holding tabs on tooth tips, and the frame's axle holes at the exact center distance. Inspired by Matthias Wandel's woodgears.ca.

name: Vaultix Sync (Beta)
author: Francis Marasigan
description: For ncSender kiosks: syncs a folder of your Vaultix cloud drive with the file manager. Sign in (two-factor codes and app passwords work), pick a folder, and its G-code files appear on the machine; files made on the kiosk go back up. Beta.

name: CNC Tutor
author: tmuka
description: Learn your CNC one short lesson at a time, on your own machine: safety, X Y Z, homing, limits and alarms, jogging, work coordinates and zeroing, tool length, reading G-code, checking and air-cutting a program, then bits, feeds and speeds, stepover, climb vs conventional and workholding. You try each step in ncSender and the tutor watches the machine and says what it saw. It never moves the machine or sends it anything.
